segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the gel controls excess oil and shine through the day and absorbs without leaving a greasy residue, several also noting fewer breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or sensitive-and-dry skin generally say the gel hydrates well and helped clear breakouts, though a few on the drier side report it doesn't fully hydrate alone and needs a heavier moisturizer layered on top.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe the gel as lightweight and non-greasy, reporting no new breakouts and a good balance between oilier and drier areas.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive mostly report the gel is gentle and non-irritating for daily use, though one reviewer with oily, textured skin found the salicylic acid left her skin irritated.
segments.normal: One reviewer cautions the formula may not hydrate enough on its own for normal or dry skin.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, describe the gel as hydrating despite its treatment ingredients; a handful on the drier side say it doesn't fully hydrate alone and needs to be layered under or over another moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report a visible reduction in redness around active breakouts, some crediting the niacinamide in the formula; none report increased redness.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers credit the ceramide complex with keeping skin feeling balanced and supported, though these read more as ingredient call-outs than detailed before/after accounts.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report fewer, smaller, or resolved breakouts within days to a few weeks of daily use; a few caution the salicylic acid can sting or irritate with overuse, and one 3-star review says it helps but doesn't fully resolve her acne.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report the gel controls shine and excess oil through the day without a greasy after-feel; none report the product making their skin oilier.

aspects.libelle: Tacky or sticky as it sets

I was offered by Peace Out Skincare in exchange for my honest review. I was very excited to try this! I have oily and textured skin for reference. I absolutely love the gel texture. It is extremely lightweight and like a nice drink of water for my skin. It didn't leave me oily or greasy which I love! I also love the acne fighting ingredients in it. Unfortunately, salicylic acid can leaves my skin irritated and that is what happened when I used this. Other than that, it is a great moisturizer for oily and acne-prone skin!

Gifted by peaceoutskincare. This has a light fresh scent. The consistency is very smooth and creamy. It provides a nice light level hydration for oily skin. It might not hydrate enough for acne prone dry or normal skin. This is great to balance out skin for great makeup application and wear.

Gifted by peaceoutskincare. The Acne Gel Moisturizer has been a fantastic addition to my routine, and I could tell it was made with acne-prone skin in mind. The gel texture is incredibly lightweight and soothing, absorbing quickly without leaving any sticky or greasy residue. From the first application, my skin felt refreshed, hydrated, and balanced, which is a must for someone like me who struggles with oily yet sensitive skin. After just a few days of use, I noticed a reduction in redness around active breakouts and an overall improvement in my skin's clarity. The moisturizer contains ingredients like salicylic acid, which targets blemishes without over-drying or irritating my skin. I also love that it helps to control excess oil throughout the day while still keeping my skin moisturized and comfortable. Over time, my skin has become smoother, with fewer breakouts and a more even tone. It layers perfectly under sunscreen or makeup, making it easy to use both morning and night. The Acne Gel Moisturizer is gentle yet effective, and it's quickly become a staple in my routine. If you're looking for a moisturizer that addresses acne while keeping your skin healthy and hydrated, this is an excellent choice!

Gifted by peace out skin care. I have been absolutely in love with this line lately. I'm slowly switching over from expensive "medical grade" skincare. It's all rubbish. This line is so much better than what I was using, and gives faster results too. I am very oily, especially in the summer. This helps keep my oil at bay, which helps keep the zits away. It's not full of fragrance. It's a very light gel moisturizer. Bonus points for the built in spatula. I always lose those things so fast. I love that I just stick this back in the cap. Genius.

I have very sensitive and dry skin so I always hesitate to try new products, especially for acne treatment. Purchased the Acne Gel Moisturizer a few weeks ago and my skin loves it! It feels so smooth when applying it and it helped clear my breakouts and keep my skin clear afterwards.

Gifted by Peace Out. My skin is naturally prone to acne as well as combination more on the oily side. I love the fact that this moisturizer is a gel so it is not heavy as well as not greasy at all. I did not notice any new breakouts when using or after use of this moisturizer!
